preconditions.description: The current time must be provided as a string.
The current time string must be in the format 'HH:MM'.
The current time string must have a colon separating hours and minutes.
The hours and minutes parts of the current time string must be digits.
The hours must be between 0 and 23, and the minutes must be between 0 and 59.

postconditions.description: The number of minutes until the next bus must be non-negative.
The number of minutes until the next bus must be at most 14.
The number of minutes until the next bus is calculated correctly based on the current time.
